title: winey nostalgic mediterranean clams bake
description: a wine-infused twist on traditional mediterranean clams bake, perfect for a cozy dinner with friends and family. inspired by the flavors of the mediterranean, this dish is sure to become a new favorite.
instructions: preheat the wood-fired salt block to 450	9c
in a large bowl, combine the clams, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, thyme, salt, and black pepper
add the white wine to the bowl and toss to coat
place the clams in a single layer on the salt block
bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the clams are opened and the wine is bubbly
remove the clams from the oven and sprinkle with parsley
serve immediately, garnished with lemon wedges
